description: This file defines a PHP class 'Search' within the OpenCart framework that handles adding customer search records to the database. It extends a base model class and encapsulates the database insertion logic for storing search data such as keywords, category, description, and other metadata.

classes.name: Search
classes.description: A model class for managing customer search records within the OpenCart account module.

methods.name: addSearch
methods.description: Inserts a new customer search record into the database with provided search details and configuration values.
